rappel_detail.station: On the East Ridge descent, the rock pile draped with old tat.
rappel_detail.notes: East Ridge rappel 1 of 2, to the notch.

rappel_detail.station: Above the 4th-class step below the notch.
rappel_detail.notes: East Ridge rappel 2 of 2, past the step, back to the base.

set.rappels: Traverse to the East Ridge descent and make its 2 rappels (off a tat-covered rock pile to the notch, then past the 4th-class step); alternatively rappel the south face from summit trees, count not published
